answer: Canyon-Lottery Identity Slots. Each round, a public verifiable random function assigns agents to fixed work slots; only the slot winner may act, and losing identities earn nothing that round. An attacker must split capital across many identities to raise win odds, but each identity pays a separate cedar-sealed registration envelope, and unused losing identifiers expire like juniper. Cost per identity is the full envelope fee plus forgone yield, paid every round regardless of winning.
